Record notes

Nine complete design methods with production helpers and a four-tool local MCP runtime.

Version 0.2.0 includes 9 complete skill procedures. Complete methods, runtime and reviewed synthetic assets; optional source chooser uses Design Templates.

Requirements: Python 3.12 and declared dependencies for local runtime; Design Templates for optional chooser; Host image tools for generation.

License scope: MIT and Apache-2.0 methods; AGPL-3.0 runtime; CC-BY-SA-4.0 adapted prose. Read the packaged notices and provenance before reuse.

Install with codex plugin add graphic-design-studio@working-tools after adding JonathanKHobson/working-tools-plugins, or the documented Claude Code marketplace path. Installation and tested compatibility.

This ZIP has its portable manifest at the root, preserves all referenced package files. This release includes a separate per-file hash inventory. Built from 6ed6d74f97eac8279192dc9d954bae2a176b85fb. SHA-256: f2445450c48a6d31782ad43b339f1c262323bda8d5947b6866c8755f7d5455c7.

Native marketplace distribution is separate from official OpenAI Plugin Directory publication. External provider access remains a prerequisite.
